concerns.location: spec.md:FR-001 vs plan.md:Technical Context / research.md:Dataset Strategy
concerns.text: FR-001 requires extraction 'from 3-5 specified GitHub repositories', but the plan sources all data from a single HuggingFace Parquet file (prs-v2-sample). No plan element addresses the 3-5 repository requirement or documents a spec amendment. Either the spec must be amended to the single-dataset design or the plan needs a repository-selection element.

Constitution VI mandates review data 'MUST be obtained directly from the GitHub API as raw pull-request diffs and associated issue metadata'. The plan fetches a pre-packaged HF Parquet instead. This is a constitution-vs-plan contradiction that needs a documented amendment or a plan change.

SC-004 requires recording total runtime for 500 PRs on a 2-CPU runner and comparing against a target threshold. No task (T004′–T013) or report field is assigned to capture/record total runtime; the RuntimeGuard only enforces the 6h deadline. Add runtime recording to T013's final_report.json or a dedicated task.

US-1's independent test and acceptance scenario specify a 10-PR extraction check with populated diff/comments/linked_issue_ids; the plan's smoke test uses a 5-PR fixture (T005′, integration test). Either add a 10-PR extraction verification step or note the equivalence explicitly.
